Class TUIContext

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.TUIContext
public class TUIContext extends Object
Central context of the textual client and holder of its shared, long-lived collaborators: the ConnectionFactory, the TUIDrawer used to render to the terminal, the TUIInputReader used to read user input and, once established, the ServerAdapter and the local player's nickname.

It also drives the screen-state machine: the current BaseTUIController represents the active screen, and changeState(BaseTUIController) switches to a new one — re-pointing the server adapter's update handler at it so incoming server messages are routed to the screen now on display.
